Repeated inspection of identical bytes yields equivalent diagnostic ordering. Independent structural assertions detect missing required fields and a non-empty authorizes array even if the candidate schema is weakened.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Author scripts/sc/tests/test_skill_quality_core.py::test_a06 to call scripts.sc.validate_skill_quality.validate_package directly and additionally inspect fresh CLI JSON through literal subprocess argv, shell=False, repository cwd and a finite timeout. This constraint retains a non-expected-red role. Missing production imports, absent planned tests, invalid fixtures and environment failures are blockers or harness failures, never causal RED.
